summary: Minimal one-line fix resolves the UnboundLocalError by ensuring 'kern' is always bound before the later unconditional 'hit = kern in s' check; using '' as the default is a bit incidental (it makes hit truthy even when no space-kerning occurred) but since Symbol('') never appears in the parsed expression the subsequent subs is a no-op, so no observed behavioral regression.

issues.description: kern = '' as a sentinel makes 'hit = kern in s' trivially True whenever no space substitution happened, which is semantically odd (relies on Symbol('') not appearing in the sympified expression) rather than being an explicit, self-documenting guard like tracking hit separately.
